- [ ] Editor available only in needs_review; save attempts in other statuses are rejected

- [ ] Both PDFs re-rendered after save (asserted via the fake PdfRenderer)

title: Application actions: state machine transitions
description:
## Parent

applyr-u3e

## What to build

The user moves Applications through their lifecycle from the detail page using named buttons (Reject / Retry / Regenerate / Mark Applied / Undo), offered only when valid for the current status. A single state machine owns the transition table and rejects anything else. Retry, Regenerate, and an Undo that lands in pending_tailoring queue tailoring again; on Regenerate the old TailoredApplication stays current (and visible) until a new one replaces it. A reject while tailoring is in flight is honoured by the tailoring job's pending_tailoring guard.

Transition table (from the spec / applyr-n58.4):

- create -> pending_tailoring
- pending_tailoring -> needs_review / tailoring_failed / rejected
- tailoring_failed -> pending_tailoring (retry) / rejected
- needs_review -> pending_tailoring (regenerate) / applied / rejected
- applied -> needs_review (undo)
- rejected -> previous_status (undo)
- previous_status is set on entering applied or rejected; applied_at and rejected_at are set and cleared accordingly

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every allowed transition works through dashboard routes with correct timestamps and previous_status
- [ ] Every disallowed transition is rejected through the routes and leaves the Application unchanged
- [ ] Undo of rejected restores the exact previous status (from pending_tailoring, tailoring_failed, and needs_review)
- [ ] Retry, Regenerate, and undo-into-pending_tailoring queue tailoring
- [ ] Regenerate keeps the old TailoredApplication current until the new one replaces it; a failed regeneration still leaves the old documents viewable
- [ ] Detail page shows only the buttons valid for the current status
- [ ] Rejecting a pending_tailoring Application before its job runs results in no Gemini call and status stays rejected

## Blocked by

- applyr-u3e.13
close_reason: State machine actions implemented with route, buttons, and tests

title: Gemini throttling and 429 backoff
description:
## Parent

applyr-u3e

## What to build

A burst of new Jobs doesn't exhaust the Gemini free-tier quota. Gemini calls go through a queue rate limiter (about 8 per minute, configurable). An HTTP 429 from Gemini releases the tailoring job with exponential backoff and does not use up a validation attempt: the rate-limit retry path and the regeneration path stay separate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rate limit configurable, default ~8/minute; excess tailoring jobs are released rather than calling Gemini
- [ ] A 429 raises the typed rate-limited error and the job is released with exponential backoff
- [ ] A 429 does not consume a regeneration attempt (e.g. with limit 3, a 429 followed by invalid, invalid, valid still ends in needs_review)
- [ ] Rate limiting and backoff tested by moving time forward, not sleeping

## Blocked by

- applyr-u3e.9
close_reason: Closed

title: Tailoring fact validation and regeneration
description:
## Parent

applyr-u3e

## What to build

Invalid AI content never becomes a document. Every AI response is fact-validated in code before rendering. A failed attempt is thrown away and a fresh one generated, up to a configurable limit (default 3); when the limit is exhausted the Application becomes tailoring_failed (dashboard only, no Telegram message in v1). An entry the AI leaves out falls back to its original MasterProfile text word for word.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Validation fails on: unknown entry_id, duplicated entry_id, more achievements than the MasterProfile entry has, empty required summary or cover-letter paragraph, output not matching the schema
- [ ] Omitted entries appear in cv_data with original description and achievements unchanged
- [ ] Gemini fake sequences cover: valid first attempt; invalid-then-valid (ends needs_review, only the valid result stored); invalid until exhausted (ends tailoring_failed, no TailoredApplication, no PDF rendered)
- [ ] Regeneration limit read from config, default 3
- [ ] Titles, companies, dates and skills in the snapshot always equal MasterProfile values regardless of AI output

## Blocked by

- applyr-u3e.9
notes: From u3e.9: entry_id is prefixed by kind ('experience:12', 'education:3', 'project:5') both in the prompt and in cv_data, since row ids collide across tables. DocumentSnapshots already falls back to original text for omitted entries (needs its test). Gemini exceptions are not yet caught by TailorApplication.
close_reason: Fact validation (TailoringResponseValidator) + regeneration loop bounded by applyr.tailoring.regeneration_limit, ending tailoring_failed

title: Tailoring tracer bullet: new Application to TailoredApplication in needs_review
description:
## Parent

applyr-u3e

## What to build

Tracer bullet for AI tailoring, happy path only. When a new Application is created in pending_tailoring, a queued tailoring job starts. It first re-checks that the Application is still pending_tailoring and exits quietly if not. It builds a prompt from the Job (title, company, description) and the MasterProfile, sending each Experience/Education/Project entry with its entry_id, its facts as read-only context, and its reframeable text. It calls the AI provider interface with the narrow response schema; the Gemini implementation calls generateContent with responseSchema over Laravel's HTTP client using the configured model and key. On a valid response it assembles the cv_data and cover_letter_data snapshots, renders both PDFs through the PdfRenderer interface, creates the TailoredApplication, repoints current_tailored_application_id, moves the Application to needs_review, and sends a Telegram review notification (Job title, company, platform, dashboard link) via the existing Telegram notifier.

Blade views here are a minimal first version that render from the snapshot only; full layout fidelity is a separate ticket. Fact validation/regeneration and Gemini throttling are separate tickets.

Response schema (from the spec):

```
{ professional_summary: string,
  entries: [{ entry_id, description, achievements: string[] }],
  cover_letter: { opening_paragraph, body_paragraphs: string[], closing_paragraph } }
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AI provider interface (prompt + JSON schema in -> decoded data out) with typed rate-limited and provider errors; Gemini implementation; the pipeline depends only on the interface
- [ ] PdfRenderer interface (HTML in -> PDF file path out) with a Browsershot implementation and a test fake that records received HTML and writes a placeholder file
- [ ] tailored_applications schema per spec; applications has current_tailored_application_id
- [ ] A poll that creates a new Application runs tailoring end to end in tests (sync queue): with Gemini faked to a valid response, the Application ends in needs_review with a current TailoredApplication and two PDF paths
- [ ] Outbound Gemini request asserted: responseSchema present, entries sent with entry_ids and facts
- [ ] cv_data: personal_info facts + reframed summary + photo_path/show_photo, skills copied word for word, entries keyed by entry_id with copied facts + reframed text
- [ ] cover_letter_data: date, subject "Re: Application for {job title}", greeting "Dear {company_name} Hiring Team", sign-off "Sincerely, {full_name}", plus the three AI paragraph fields
- [ ] Telegram review notification sent with Job title, company, platform and dashboard link
- [ ] Tailoring job exits without calling Gemini if the Application is no longer pending_tailoring

## Blocked by

- applyr-u3e.3
- applyr-u3e.5

title: Adapter health: classify failures, auto-pause, Telegram alert
description:
## Parent

applyr-u3e

## What to build

Adapters watch their own health. A shared, platform-agnostic queue-layer handler wraps each Adapter run, catches the four typed exceptions, and updates per-platform health state. Broken-track failures (anti-bot, API error, shape drift; mixed categories count together) pause the Adapter at 3 consecutive failed runs. Transport failures are retried with backoff within a run, the run counts once, and escalate at 6 consecutive failed runs. A run that finishes cleanly resets both counters; a failure on one track doesn't reset the other. Crossing a threshold sets status to paused and sends exactly one Telegram alert (no repeat reminders); the scheduler skips paused Adapters. Glints and JobStreet health are independent.

This ticket builds the Telegram notifier (Bot API sendMessage over Laravel's HTTP client to the one configured chat), which the tailoring tracer bullet reuses for review notifications.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Adapter health state stored one row per platform: status {healthy, failing, paused}, broken and transport counters, first_failure_at/last_failure_at for the current streak, last_success_at, last failure category/status code/error snippet, bounded recent-failure log (category + timestamp)
- [ ] Each failure category is classified and recorded correctly (403 + Cf-Mitigated: challenge -> anti-bot)
- [ ] Broken track pauses at 3 consecutive failures, including mixed categories; transport track pauses at 6; below threshold status is failing
- [ ] Within-run transport retries with backoff count as one failure (tested by moving time, not sleeping)
- [ ] A clean run resets both counters and records last_success_at
- [ ] Exactly one Telegram alert when a threshold is crossed, containing platform, failure category, count vs threshold, first and last failure times, status code, short error snippet, and a note that the Adapter is paused; outbound payload asserted via HTTP fake
- [ ] Scheduled poll skips paused Adapters; one platform's failures don't affect the other

## Blocked by

- applyr-u3e.3
close_reason: Adapter health tracking, auto-pause, Telegram alert implemented; 131 tests pass

title: JobStreet Adapter
description:
## Parent

The JobStreet Adapter implements the shared Adapter interface: POST id.jobstreet.com/graphql (never jobstreet.co.id), jobSearchV7(params: JobSearchV7QueryInput!) with a client-generated sessionId and searchContext brand/intent/source, sending the full realistic browser header set (Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua*, User-Agent). JobStreet Jobs flow through the existing upsert/pivot/Application pipeline unchanged.

Build step, not a blocker: where keyword, location, date range and pagination go inside JobSearchV7QueryInput is not yet known (introspection is disabled). Capture one real outgoing request from browser devtools, save it as a fixture, and implement the mapping against it. See the bd memory on JobStreet GraphQL and applyr-n58.1 notes.

- [ ] A captured real browser request and a real response body are saved as fixtures
- [ ] SearchProfile translated into JobSearchV7QueryInput as far as JobStreet supports; unsupported filters approximated or ignored, never fatal
- [ ] Job mapping: posted_date<-listedAt, url<-url, description<-abstract, country_code from the request context, status derived from expiry when available otherwise "unknown" (never assumed open), min/max years of experience null, salary kept as reported, raw_payload stored
- [ ] Failures throw the same four typed exceptions as the Glints Adapter (403 + Cf-Mitigated: challenge, GraphQL errors, shape drift on 200, connection failure)
- [ ] Tests prove the outbound request (URL, headers, payload shape), normalization, pagination/page cap, and that JobStreet Jobs dedup independently of Glints (platform is part of the key)

title: Glints polling tracer bullet: poll command to Jobs, matches and Applications
description:
## Parent

applyr-u3e

## What to build

Tracer bullet for finding Jobs, using Glints. When the scheduled poll command runs, it queues one run per Adapter; the Glints run covers every active SearchProfile, calls Glints' internal GraphQL job-search API (POST glints.com/api/v2/graphql, searchJobsV3) with a realistic browser User-Agent, pages up to a configurable page cap with pacing between requests, and normalizes each posting into a canonical Job. Each Job is upserted by (platform, external_id); a (Job, SearchProfile) pivot row is recorded the first time that pair is seen; and only a newly created Job gets exactly one Application in pending_tailoring. A Job seen again is refreshed in place (core fields, status, raw_payload) and never gets a second Application.

This ticket establishes the shared Adapter interface (SearchProfile in -> canonical Job data + raw payload out) and the four typed failure exceptions (anti-bot blocked, transport, API error, shape drift), which the Glints Adapter throws. Health handling of those exceptions is a separate ticket. See the bd memory on Glints GraphQL and applyr-n58.1 notes for the request/response facts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] jobs schema per spec with a composite unique index on (platform, external_id); job_search_profile_matches pivot with matched_at; applications table with job_id unique and the status enum
- [ ] Poll schedule is configurable, defaulting to a conservative interval (e.g. hourly)
- [ ] Glints Adapter translates SearchProfile: keyword->SearchTerm, country->CountryCode, post_date_range->lastUpdatedAtRange, experience->min/maxYearsOfExperience, work arrangement->isRemote/workArrangementOptions, location resolved to Glints location/city IDs best-effort; unsupported filters are approximated or ignored, never fatal
- [ ] Job mapping: posted_date<-createdAt (not startDate/expiryDate), url<-externalApplyURL, description<-descriptionJsonString flattened to text, status mapped from Glints status, salary kept as reported (min, max, currency, period) with no conversion, raw_payload stores the full posting JSON
- [ ] A 200 response without GraphQL errors that can't map a required canonical field throws shape drift; 403 with Cf-Mitigated: challenge throws anti-bot; a GraphQL errors array throws API error; connection failure throws transport
- [ ] Tests (fixture-based, HTTP faked) prove: normalization, outbound request payload, dedup/upsert, pivot rows, one Application per Job across two overlapping SearchProfiles, no new Application on re-poll, status refresh on re-poll, paused SearchProfiles not polled, page cap respected
- [ ] Fixtures are real Glints response bodies saved as JSON

## Blocked by

- applyr-u3e.2
close_reason: Glints polling tracer bullet implemented: applyr:poll schedule -> PollAdapter per Adapter -> GlintsAdapter (searchJobsV3, location lookup, paging with cap, pacing, Chrome TLS prefs) -> Job upsert, match pivot, one pending_tailoring Application per new Job. Four typed Adapter exceptions. 17 fixture-based tests from real Glints bodies. Deviations agreed with user: description via getJobById only for new Jobs; anonymous page>=2 NO_PERMISSION ends paging.
