title: Applyr Wayfinder Map
description:
## Destination

A complete technical spec — SearchProfile schema, canonical Job model, MasterProfile schema (with its dashboard-form design), Application status-tracking design, a single generic CV/cover-letter HTML template design, and an adapter monitoring/alerting strategy — for an automated job-application assistant covering **Glints and JobStreet only**. Ready to hand off for implementation. This map is planning-only, except prototype tickets that validate high-risk external facts before architecture is locked in.

## Notes

• Domain vocabulary is locked in CONTEXT.md at repo root (SearchProfile, Adapter, Job, MasterProfile, TailoredApplication, Application). Consult it before any ticket that touches these terms; challenge and update it if a ticket's answer sharpens or conflicts with a definition.
• Fixed architectural decisions — do NOT re-grill these, they came pre-settled from the user:
    • Scraping: adapter pattern per platform (fetch/parse/normalize); check for an internal JSON API before falling back to HTML parsing (selector or Browsershot headless).
    • Dedup by platform+external_id, checked BEFORE a Job enters AI tailoring.
    • AI tailoring: Gemini API Flash (free tier). Hard constraint: title/company/period must match MasterProfile exactly; AI may only reframe description/achievements.
    • AI output must be structured JSON via Gemini's responseSchema, never freeform-parsed text.
    • Programmatic fact validation before render; a failed validation triggers regeneration (discard the failed attempt, don't keep it).
    • Rate limiting for Gemini free tier (~8 req/min via queue rate limiter). 429s use exponential backoff; validation-failure retries use regenerate logic — these two retry paths stay separate, never merged.
    • Render pipeline: validated JSON → Blade HTML template → PDF via Browsershot.
    • Notifications: Telegram bot + dashboard web (not WhatsApp). Dashboard is also where the user reviews/edits before applying and tracks application status.
    • AI provider abstracted behind one interface, so swapping providers later doesn't require touching the pipeline.
    • Stack: Laravel (queue jobs, Blade templating).
• Skills to consult per ticket: grilling + domain-modeling for schema/design tickets; the "prototype" skill for the platform-API validation ticket.
• CV/cover-letter template: one generic template for v1 — no per-role variants (see Out of scope).
• Adapter monitoring/alerting reuses the Telegram bot channel; alert after consecutive failures, not on the first failure.
• MasterProfile is authored/edited via a dashboard form, not a config file.
• Platform investigation order: Glints before JobStreet.

## Decisions so far

• **applyr-n58.1 (closed)**: Both Glints and JobStreet expose directly-callable, unauthenticated internal GraphQL JSON APIs for job search — no HTML-selector parsing or Browsershot fallback needed for either platform. Glints: POST glints.com/api/v2/graphql, searchJobsV3, introspection enabled. JobStreet: POST id.jobstreet.com/graphql (not jobstreet.co.id, which redirects), jobSearchV7, introspection disabled, schema recovered from frontend JS. Both sit behind Cloudflare bot-mitigation that was satisfied by realistic browser headers alone (no JS challenge solved, no auth/cookies needed). Full field-shape findings captured on the issue for n58.5 (canonical Job model) to consume; Cloudflare-challenge response signature captured for n58.7 (monitoring/alerting) to alert on.
• **applyr-n58.6 (closed)**: Single generic CV/cover-letter template design locked. Two separate PDFs per TailoredApplication (cv.pdf, cover_letter.pdf), minimalist single-column Inter (self-hosted) layout with section-separator rules. TailoredApplication's cv_data/cover_letter_data JSON are full self-contained snapshots (copied facts + reframed content, keyed by MasterProfile entry id) — the Gemini responseSchema itself stays narrow (only description/achievements per entry, only the three cover-letter paragraph fields), since skills and the cover letter's greeting/date/subject/sign-off are deterministic facts assembled by the app, never sent to the AI. Achievements may be curated down when reframed but never invented beyond MasterProfile's list. Amends MasterProfile (n58.3) with an optional photo (photo_path + show_photo toggle), rendered top-left in the CV header only.
• **applyr-n58.7 (closed)**: Adapter monitoring/alerting strategy locked. Four-category failure taxonomy per Adapter (Glints/JobStreet counted independently): anti-bot block (403 + `Cf-Mitigated: challenge`, the signature n58.1 observed), transport failure (timeout/DNS/connection), structured API error (non-2xx or GraphQL `errors` array), response-shape drift (200 OK but fails to map onto expected Job fields — the JSON-API analog of "selector changed"; HTML-parse-exception dropped from the taxonomy since neither Adapter parses HTML per n58.1). Detected inside each Adapter via typed exceptions, counted by a shared platform-agnostic queue-layer handler. Two tracks: anti-bot block + API error + shape drift share one "broken" counter (threshold 3 consecutive, mixed categories count together); transport failures get their own leash (threshold 6 consecutive) before escalating into the same alert/pause path. Any success resets the counter to 0. Crossing a threshold fires exactly one Telegram alert (platform, category, count-vs-threshold, first/last failure timestamps, status code + truncated error snippet, note that it's paused) and auto-pauses the Adapter — no further scheduled runs, no repeat/nagging reminders. Resume is dashboard-only (not via Telegram): a Resume button resets the counter to 0 and re-enters the normal schedule, no special immediate-retry path. Dashboard gets an Adapters view: per-Adapter status (Healthy / Failing n-of-threshold / Paused), last successful run, last failure detail, Resume button when Paused, short recent-failure history log. Zero-results-but-clean-response (200, valid shape, 0 jobs across consecutive runs) explicitly deferred — indistinguishable from a legitimately quiet SearchProfile without a separate baselining design.

## Not yet specified

• Dashboard deployment/hosting details beyond "single-user, no-auth" — not yet explored.
• Implementation order/build roadmap beyond this spec map (this map produces a spec, not a build schedule).
• Zero-results-as-silent-breakage detection (deferred out of n58.7's scope).

## Out of scope

• LinkedIn adapter — ToS/anti-bot risk is a different class than Glints/JobStreet; a separate effort if pursued later.
• Multi-user/auth dashboard — this is a personal tool, not a multi-tenant product.
• Per-role CV/cover-letter template variants (e.g. SA vs QA) — v1 destination is one generic template; variants are ruled out of this map's scope, not merely deferred.

Full technical spec locked — SearchProfile schema, canonical Job model, MasterProfile schema + dashboard form, Application status-tracking flow, CV/cover-letter HTML template, adapter monitoring/alerting strategy, plus the Glints/JobStreet platform-API prototype. Ready to hand off for implementation.

title: Decide: show weekly/daily/hourly/per-project salary periods instead of unspecified
description: Found in applyr-u3e.16. Glints salaryMode also reports WEEK, DAY, HOUR, PROJECT and '' (live samples 654d5b11 DAY, d92b26f7 HOUR, 9f430571 WEEK bonus, b017c03c PROJECT bonus, 2a19f54f blank SGD 25-50). JobStreet hourly already maps to unspecified. Job::salaryRange() then shows e.g. 'IDR 150,000 – 250,000' with no period, which reads like a monthly salary. Adding SalaryPeriod cases needs a migration for the jobs.salary_period enum column. Also note: when a posting has only BONUS salaries, salary() picks the bonus as the salary.

title: Glints describe() throws on a deleted posting instead of returning an empty description
description: Found in applyr-u3e.16. getJobById for a deleted job returns HTTP 404 with body errors[0].extensions.code RECORD_NOT_FOUND and data null (e.g. id 03e605cb-03be-4edd-8701-5353cb56223b). GlintsAdapter::guardHttpFailure turns that into an ApiErrorException, so the 'posting removed since the search' branch in describe() (descriptionJsonString null) never runs. Decide whether a 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND should return '' or skip the Job, and add a fixture.

title: Glints Job status never leaves open: search only serves OPEN postings
description: Found in applyr-u3e.16. searchJobsV3 only returns OPEN postings (2070/2070 sampled across ID/SG/MY/VN/TW), so a Job that Glints closes or expires just drops out of the results and re-polling never refreshes it. Its status stays open forever, though CONTEXT.md says re-polling is how status (open/closed/expired) becomes observable. The adapter now maps CLOSED to closed/expired correctly, but only if a posting is fetched after it closes. Fix: re-check stored open Glints Jobs via getJobById (status, closedAt, expiryDate), or treat expiryDate in the past as expired. Check whether JobStreet has the same gap.

title: Tailoring that gives up leaves the Application stuck in pending_tailoring
description: TailorApplication has no failed() handler. When it fails (a ProviderException, a PDF render error, or retryUntil running out after a day of 429 backoff), the Application stays pending_tailoring and the dashboard shows nothing. Found in the review of applyr-u3e.11. Consider marking it tailoring_failed in failed().

title: Decide: should an empty reframed description/achievements fall back to MasterProfile text?
description: From u3e.10 review: validation accepts an entry returned with description '' or achievements [], which then blanks that entry's text in cv_data. The spec only names empty summary and cover-letter paragraphs as failures. Decide whether empty entry text should fail validation or fall back to the original MasterProfile text.

title: Regenerate when Gemini returns unreadable (non-JSON) content
description: From u3e.10 review: GeminiProvider throws ProviderException when the response text is not JSON or not an object. TailorApplication's regeneration loop only retries responses that fail TailoringResponseValidator, so a malformed body escapes the job instead of counting as a failed attempt toward the regeneration limit / tailoring_failed. Decide whether malformed content should be a retryable attempt (distinct from HTTP/connection ProviderExceptions, which u3e.11 covers).
close_reason: Unreadable Gemini content (no text, non-JSON, non-object) raises MalformedResponseException and counts as a failed regeneration attempt; HTTP/connection errors still fail the job

title: Tailoring skipped when no MasterProfile is saved leaves Application stuck in pending_tailoring
description: TailorApplication (applyr-u3e.9) exits with a log warning when no MasterProfile row exists, leaving the Application in pending_tailoring with nothing re-queuing it. Decide: mark tailoring_failed (so Retry works), or re-queue pending Applications when the MasterProfile is first saved.
close_reason: TailorApplication now marks the Application tailoring_failed when no MasterProfile exists, so Retry works (user decision).

title: MasterProfile: remove an uploaded photo
description: applyr-u3e.7 lets the user upload and replace a profile photo but not clear it; unticking show_photo only hides it from CVs. Add a Remove photo action on the MasterProfile page that deletes the file and nulls photo_path. Found in code review of applyr-u3e.7.
close_reason: Remove photo action added on MasterProfile page: DELETE master-profile/photo deletes the file and nulls photo_path; show_photo untouched; snapshots keep their own copy.

title: Extract shared GraphQL plumbing from Glints and JobStreet Adapters
description: Found in review of applyr-u3e.4. GlintsAdapter and JobStreetAdapter carry identical copies of guardHttpFailure, data, pace, snippet, required and the send try/catch + JSON guard, differing only in Platform. Tests duplicate too: each polling test's setUp fakes every other Adapter as empty, and both classes repeat assertPollFails/fixture/fake-pages helpers. Extract a shared GraphQL HTTP client (or helper taking a Platform) and a TestCase helper that fakes all Adapters except the one under test, so a third Adapter doesn't mean editing every copy.
close_reason: Closed

title: Verify Glints status and salary-mode values beyond OPEN/MONTH
description: GlintsAdapter maps Job.status OPEN/CLOSED/EXPIRED and salaryMode MONTH/YEAR, but live captures (applyr-u3e.3) only ever showed OPEN and MONTH; status and salaryMode are plain Strings in the schema (PaymentFrequency enum is DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY, a different field). Unknown values fall back to status unknown / salary_period unspecified, so a closed job could silently show as unknown. Find real non-open postings (e.g. getJobById on an old id, or a closed job URL) and confirm the actual strings; update the mapping and fixtures.
close_reason: Verified live: status enum OPEN/CLOSED/IN_REVIEW/DELETED (no EXPIRED); CLOSED maps to expired when closed at end of expiry day; salaryMode also WEEK/DAY/HOUR/PROJECT/'' (map to unspecified). Follow-ups u3e.23-25.
